Select a national team to inspect its dynamic match-by-match trajectory under the **3-Elo Complete** model:

```{python}
import plotly.graph_objects as go
from plotly.subplots import make_subplots
import pandas as pd
import os

data_path = '../paper_scripts/data/ratings_3eloC_spain.csv'

if os.path.exists(data_path):
    df_spain = pd.read_csv(data_path)
    df_spain['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df_spain['date'])
    df_spain = df_spain[df_spain['date'] >= '2000-01-01'].sort_values('date')
    
    fig = make_subplots(specs=[[{"secondary_y": True}]])
    
    # Overall Elo
    fig.add_trace(
        go.Scatter(x=df_spain['date'], y=df_spain['elo'], name="Overall Elo (R^e)", line=dict(color='#ef4444', width=3)),
        secondary_y=False
    )
    
    # Offensive Elo
    fig.add_trace(
        go.Scatter(x=df_spain['date'], y=df_spain['elo_off'], name="Offensive Elo (R^o)", line=dict(color='#f59e0b', width=2, dash='dash')),
        secondary_y=True
    )
    
    # Defensive Elo
    fig.add_trace(
        go.Scatter(x=df_spain['date'], y=df_spain['elo_def'], name="Defensive Elo (R^d)", line=dict(color='#6366f1', width=2, dash='dot')),
        secondary_y=True
    )
    
    fig.update_layout(
        title="Spain Historical Elo Rating Dynamics (2000–2026)",
        template="plotly_dark",
        height=600,
        xaxis_title="Match Calendar Date"
    )
    
    fig.update_yaxes(title_text="Overall Rating Points (R^e)", secondary_y=False)
    fig.update_yaxes(title_text="Style Rating Points (R^o, R^d)", secondary_y=True)
    
    fig.show()
else:
    print("Ratings data file for Spain not found. Run `python paper_scripts/run_compute_team.py spain` to generate.")
```
